rubric.initial: 16/16 status matches; any compatible allowed issue kind on FAIL; no issues on PASS; reasoning and repair reviewed separately
rubric.endToEnd: 9/9 expected defects detected and repaired in one proposal, blind quality PASS, correct key valid with no semantic alternatives, local constraints and goal preservation
rubric.scope: synthetic cases only; no course data or official exam approvals
rubric.limits: 50 physical launches including all retries; one candidate and one correction round per failing defective case; never correct positive controls
